t: Malta Public Transport announces special shuttle services for Imnarja
html:
Malta Public Transport has announced special shuttle services for the traditional Imnarja feast taking place in Buskett on 28th and  29th June 2025. The service is designed to offer an alternative and convenient transport option for attendees, which includes parking in designated areas.

All personalised Tallinja Card holders can travel free of charge on these special service trips.

To facilitate travel, Malta Public Transport will be operating regular shuttle services from two Park and Ride locations: one based in Infetti Road, Rabat and the other in Ta’ Qali, next to the open-air gym.  The service departing from Ta’ Qali will pass through Infetti Road on the way to Buskett, while a separate service will run directly from Infetti Road to Buskett; return shuttles from Buskett will operate to both starting points.

This special service will operate between 1700hrs and 0300hrs on the 28th June, and between 0530 hrs and 1400hrs on 29th June.

An additional shuttle service will also be available from Ċirkewwa to Buskett and vice versa. On 28th June 2025, the service will depart from Ċirkewwa at 1730hrs, returning from Buskett at 2115hrs. On 29th June, the shuttle departs Ċirkewwa at 0730, returning from Buskett at 1330.

Passengers are advised to arrive at the designated bus stops on time to ensure a smooth and timely departure. For further details relating to departure times and other updates, please visit our website and follow us on our social media channels.

The Shuttle Services are designed to improve the overall experience of the Mnarja celebration, making it more accessible and enjoyable for everyone attending. By choosing the Park and Ride option, passengers can help reduce traffic congestion while benefiting from a smoother, more convenient journey to and from Buskett.
